description: Core permissions for the TTOBAK Mac App. The window loads the remote production SPA (see tauri.conf.json's `build.devUrl`/window `url`), not a local `tauri://` origin, so a capability without an explicit `remote` grant only matches the local context — commands still work (they bypass the ACL entirely when the app has no ACL manifest), but `plugin:event|listen` and other ACL-gated APIs are silently rejected for the remote origin without this.
